newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy inflation to continue lower - Istat head.
newsitem.headline: Italy inflation to continue lower - Istat head.

text.p: Favourable conditions exist for Italy's cost of living to maintain its current lower trend, Alberto Zuliani, chairman of the national statistics institute, Istat, said.

"We have a raft of indicators, ranging from production prices to average import costs and wholesale prices which all together look positive," Zuliani told reporters in reply to queries about the inflation trend in June and coming months.

On Tuesday, preliminary CPI data from the first four of 11 sample Italian cities indicated May inflation falling to 1.5 percent year-on-year from 1.7 percent in April. Istat will publish the final national figures on June 4.
The other seven cities will publish their price data at 1530 GMT on Wednesday.

Zuliani declined to go into details about the inflation trend in summer months, saying he still saw a favourable trend although it was difficult to make a direct comparison with last summer. CPI in July 1996 actually posted a month-on-month fall of 0.2 percent.
